summary.text: Zach Mako is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 183, which he has represented since December 2016, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mako assumed office in the House on December 1, 2016.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Appropriations, Finance and Professional Licensure committees.
